**UQNV : SOLT**

**XTQY : VROW**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de66ed46b9729983a6d076c3f0e81383a72595b9f98e83cc6da4e6f5dddff04a.png] 

**Applying the logic to RNKS:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2248354ed2cb2c8a71aca2bdacf5768b62475b280e06a4a8ca8e8505ee6a40de.png]
